answer: Treat every attestation as a hypothesis until a jury proves it. Juries must be diverse by construction, drawn from unrelated subnetworks and age cohorts, and a duplicate submission forfeits the whole stake attached to it. A haven of clones has no inlet to fresh jurors, so its panels mirror each other and get flagged. One zephyr of outside review is enough to expose the block. Design so the cheapest attack costs more than an honest week of work.
